docs.title: Wiki release checklist
docs.description: Release checks for search-index generation and website sync.
docs.body: Run npm run ci locally, verify generated manifests, and confirm the wiki-search workflow can sync to production.

docs.title: Website Sync Pipeline
docs.description: How the wiki-search workflow delivers data to the website backend.
docs.body: The sync endpoint accepts the full search payload with docs, pokemon, and moves so Meilisearch can be replaced atomically.
